method: Built-in image_gen. Four successful calls, one rejected template call; no CLI fallback. Approved B base and bob values reused. New outfits painted on the unchanged B underlay. Shared original alpha bounds and affine registration for every source. Separate body/face paintings use the same alpha and light facial geometry; deep pigments calibrated from the generated deep skin painting. Fixed-colour whole outfits separated with source contours, cleaned of skin and detached islands, and fitted against independent coverage/seam bands. Immutable adjacent cloth pigment closes small extraction gaps; trousers resample their own row contours to the template calves. Eye cavities retain the original B whites, iris planes and pupils; skin tint never enters them.
